_comment: Bench calibration for the robotic arm servos. Single source of truth for the standalone tools (servo_keyboard.py / servo_diff_keyboard.py). Load a joint with --joint <name>. Pulse widths in microseconds. All servos on this arm are identical continuous-rotation units.

base.notes: Base pitch+roll. Mirrored servos -> motor B inverted for clean pitch. Verified on the bench.

wrist.notes: Not yet calibrated on hardware — channels are the planned wiring.
